questions.q: You wake up in the morning. Which greeting do you say?
questions.explanation: Buenos días means 'good morning' and is used from waking up until about midday.

questions.q: It's 2:00 in the afternoon. Which greeting fits?
questions.explanation: Buenas tardes means 'good afternoon,' used from midday until it gets dark.

questions.q: The moon is out and it's time for bed. Which greeting fits?
questions.explanation: Buenas noches means 'good evening' or 'good night,' used once it's dark outside.

questions.q: Your friend asks '¿Cómo estás?' and you feel great! What do you say?
questions.explanation: Muy bien means 'very well' — the right answer when you feel great.

questions.q: You meet a brand-new classmate for the very first time. What do you say?
questions.explanation: Mucho gusto means 'nice to meet you' and is only said the first time you meet someone.

questions.q: You are leaving your friend's house. What do you say?
questions.explanation: Adiós means 'goodbye' and works no matter the time of day.
